summary: The product is available at ₹999, which is ₹100 (9%) below the market reference of ₹1,099. The M.R.P. is 17.3x the price stores actually charge.

voices.point: The display is easy to see outdoors, with a sleek, comfortable design and clear Bluetooth calling.
It features a reliable battery lasting 5-7 days and IP67 water resistance for active lifestyles.
Users appreciate its premium look, super display, and fast Bluetooth 5.1 pairing for convenience.
One user reported poor battery backup, getting 3 days instead of 5, despite good material quality.
